name: Jlesage Handbrake
tagline: This project implements a Docker container for Handbrake.
description: The GUI of the application is accessed through a modern web browser (no installation or configuration needed on the client side) or via any VNC client.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Vnc password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-jlesage-handbrake:
    container_name: big-bear-jlesage-handbrake # Name of the Docker container
    image: jlesage/handbrake:v26.09.1@sha256:6f3a121e235d34e7299080e8cbac5284060e942fb2b137f777e2521fb7af65ae # Docker image for the Handbrake
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5800" # Expose port 5800 for VNC access
    environment:
      - VNC_PASSWORD=${SECRET_VNC_PASSWORD} # Set the VNC password to 'casaos'
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config:rw
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage:/storage:ro
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/watch:/watch:rw
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/output:/output:rw
